head: f4165728412418d0c30f32d00b5174fe8121300a
verdictText: APPROVE for OWNER-RULING, with one optional in-PR test addition and four carry-forwards. No blocking finding.
reservedSlot: The original admission manifest reserved this review slot; it now binds the genuine full sensitive review.
reviewerRows: | CF-MPRU-1/3 honestly scoped out | YES; see section 5 for whether they block the reconnect journey. |
| R1 drop-id-override | adapted catalog unit keeps the catalog id instead of gameUnit.id | CAUGHT (3 failed) |

| R2 drop-custom-ref-predicate | isEngineRecoveredUnit ignores custom- refs without a recorded snapshot (they go to the catalog and silently skip) | SURVIVES - every fixture custom unit carries a recorded snapshot, so readCustom is never consulted on the new path |
| R3 unknown-ref-throws | unknown catalog ref throws instead of warn+skip | CAUGHT (6 failed) - the skip rule is pinned by the custom and journal suites, not by the new test |

| R5 suppress-outcome | fromHydratedSession with suppressOutcomePublication: true | SURVIVES - no server suite pins that a recovered session still announces CombatOutcomeReady on the engine bus; server-side outcome delivery goes through publishDurableCombatOutcome, so equivalent at this surface |
| R6 engine-lookup-by-unitref | engineById.get(gameUnit.unitRef) drops custom units | CAUGHT (1 failed) |
| R7 random-seed-plus-one | SeededRandom(seed + 1) when seeded | CAUGHT (1 failed, row 3) |
| R8 d6-seed-plus-one | SeededD6Roller(seed + 1) when seeded | CAUGHT (1 failed, row 3) |

| R9 unseeded-gets-seeded-roller | unseeded sessions get SeededD6Roller(0xc0ffee) instead of undefined | SURVIVES - equivalent in predictability (see CF-MPRU-4): with undefined the resolvers fall back to random.nextInt on SeededRandom(0xc0ffee) |
| R10 readCustom-null-in-rebuild | rebuildSessionFromEvents passes a reader that returns null | SURVIVES - same root as R2 |

| CF-MPRU-1 | new narrow unit MP-RECOVERY-UNITS-2 (or DEDUPE-1 if Root prefers), before L1-SMOKE-A2 | ServerMatchHost.recover: take units from deriveServerAdaptedUnits for co-op AND non-co-op hosts (today co-op uses fetch at boot and non-co-op passes []); only consumers are the journal-authority decideDeps, so latent while mode is 'off' |
| CF-MPRU-2 | same unit (PR says U44; either) | unmocked rewound-at-boot fixture so M8 is caught |
| CF-MPRU-3 | same unit | ServerMatchHostRewindRebuild.rebuildHostFromActivatedBranch -> recoverServerInteractiveSession (drop the live HTTP-to-self) |

| CF-MPRU-4 (new, pre-existing, Medium for the shared mission) | same unit; needs ServerMatchHost.ts | A recovered legacy-path MP host never wires its crypto RollCapture into the engine: ServerMatchHost.recover passes no sourceRoller and the session has d6Roller undefined, so every post-restart roll comes from InteractiveSession's fallback random.nextInt on SeededRandom(0xc0ffee) from position zero, and events carry no captured rolls. Dice after a restart are therefore predictable from a public constant. Byte-identical to the pre-PR fromSessionAsync behaviour (the PR deliberately preserves it); fix is to let recoverServerInteractiveSession accept an optional d6Roller and have recover pass () => host.capture.d6(). |

| CF-SMOKEA1-2 | discharged for the 1v1 combat recovery path on two independently built images (this review); L1-SMOKE-A2 may cite this report and the local receipt; co-op restart remains to be witnessed |

items.item: ServerMatchHost.recover must derive co-op and non-co-op journal units from disk via deriveServerAdaptedUnits. A2 co-op restart must witness an accepted action; current journal authority is off.
Add an unmocked rewound-at-boot fixture that catches M8.

Recovered legacy-path hosts must wire crypto RollCapture. Add optional d6Roller to recoverServerInteractiveSession; ServerMatchHost.recover passes () => host.capture.d6(). Current post-restart dice use predictable SeededRandom(0xc0ffee) with no captured rolls.
Custom-unit no-snapshot test: successful stored-definition recovery and fail-closed missing definition, rather than silent catalog skip.
Old pre-fix probe summary accepted any reply and mislabeled NoMovementCapability as accepted. Raw evidence supports the defect; independent reviewer before/after probe supersedes that summary.

Use skip detection matching both canonical catalog and server canonical catalog messages. Reviewer broader regex still finds zero skips. Jest Move acceptance is the behavioral guard; warn spy is silenced under test mode.
Independent built-image before/after restart validates accepted ordinary combat action; co-op restart acceptance remains an A2 obligation.
Recovered non-co-op journal units are currently empty.
Failed recovery falls through to a fresh host in getOrCreate.
Source PR body Main reference was stale; this receipt fetches the actual merge and verifies its integration tree.

carryForwards.registration: Root will register MP-RECOVERY-UNITS-2 in a separate docs-only PR after this closure merges, before L1-SMOKE-A2. This closure creates no unit or dependency edge for that future registration.

successorRelease.algorithm: Only newly eligible dependents of MP-RECOVERY-UNITS-1; every declared predecessor must be main-verified, complete or archived. Existing independent holds remain. Only state blocked -> planned may change.
